new_activity_id_terminates._doc: THE NEW ACTIVITY ID ENDS THE WALK. The same-activity multi-widget absorb (same_activity_multi_widget) keeps a different-type follower inside the bundle whenever the bundle belongs to a real [Activity N] — but when the follower's OWN bracket names a DIFFERENT activity id ('[Activity 3B – self marking type the answer]' inside Activity 3A's walk; the MX family types the id and the widget in one bracket, so the tag resolves to the widget and the absolute [activity] break never fires), it is a new activity (seen mostly in MX, also BLL, ARFUN, JPFUN, XMES); the gold keeps the two apart. The walk ends there and the follower opens its own bundle and activity. Only when the bundle HAS an activity id and the follower names a different one. Env ACTIDSPLIT_OFF.

owner_lookback._doc: The owner-id half (its own toggle, ACTIDOWNER_OFF). During the walk a widget bundle opened UNDER a separate [Activity N] opener has no activityId yet (the owner is attached later by the activity look-back), so the new-activity-id test above would never fire for it — ARFUN04 1G's drag-and-drop (its box opened by the heading co-tag rule) would walk on into `[Activity 1H drag and drop] [MTK Quiz …]` as a same-type continuation and swallow that quiz. When the bundle has no activityId, the nearest activity opener before it (back to max_back items, never past a PAGE_BOUNDARY or another widget opener) lends its id to the test.

dropbox_never_merges._doc: THE DROPBOX SPLIT. The student file-upload DROPBOX is never part of another activity's basket. A dropbox marker swept into a host bundle's extraTypes by same_activity_multi_widget would make every builder bail on the mixed basket (BLL156's clean three-video carousel would be refused because the upload button at the end of the activity was filed as a second widget) AND the trapped dropbox would never reach the upload-box builder, so the upload button the gold uses throughout would be lost twice over. No building non-dropDown bundle carries a dropbox member, so this changes no existing build. THE RULE IS ONE DIRECTION: a FOLLOWER resolving to the dropDown type whose text matches the upload box's OWN deny predicate (opener_deny_pattern, minus upload_box.opener_exclude_pattern — an [alert dropbox] is a REVEAL box, CEDT101, unchanged) TERMINATES the host's walk instead of absorbing; the marker then opens its own bundle and #ddUploadBox renders the gold's button. The REVERSE split (releasing a dropbox-opener HOST's foreign followers) is deliberately NOT done: it would free a [Modal] into the single-URL button path, which builds a button and silently drops the writer's paired '[button] No' member, losing writer content for no gain. The modal member handling would first have to stop swallowing an unplaceable [button]. The predicate pair is READ LIVE from interactive_builders.dropDown so the scanner and the builder can never drift. Env DBXSPLIT_OFF.

closer_never_opens._doc: THE CLOSER THAT OPENS ITS OWN WIDGET. A bare '[close modal]' is the writer's END DELIMITER, not a fresh invocation, and the modal walk consumes it as a no-op at the OPEN site (member_rule.modal_gathering.closer_pattern, types ['modal']). The identical shape would still open useless one-marker bundles for two other families, because the lexicon aliases 'end accordion'/'end carousel' to CONTAINER_CLOSE but not the writer's 'close'/'finish' spellings, which fall through to the plain INTERACTIVE tag — each would render an empty hand-off box on a finished page (as with ENGJ402 p6.0 '[Finish carousel]', MXFL301 p2.0 + p3.0 and MXFU301 p8.0 '[close accordion]'). Most closer-shaped spans already resolve CONTAINER_CLOSE; the rest resolve INTERACTIVE. A lexicon change to CONTAINER_CLOSE is not used because EXPFUN04/05's BUILT tile modals absorb many interleaved closers mid-walk and would shatter; for accordion and carousel, bundles that carry a closer ALONGSIDE other members are already declining (ENGI405 p1.0, ENGJ403 p1.0 + p5.0, MXFU301 p9.0), so no built bundle is at risk. FENCES: the rule fires ONLY at the OPEN site (a closer met mid-walk keeps the normal behaviour, so nothing a working walk relies on moves); ONLY for a bundle whose type is in `types`; and ONLY when the span is BARE — a closer bracket carrying any other word keeps the normal behaviour, so a writer instruction riding the bracket can never be silently dropped. clickDrop is DELIBERATELY NOT in `types`: its closer spans are in the BLL27x/ENGJ403 families, whose clickDrop walks follow their own gathering rules, and consuming their closers would change bundle boundaries there. Env CLOSEROPEN_OFF.

modal_gathering._doc: THE ONE-SENTENCE MODAL FAMILY. Without a boundary-bank entry, headings would TERMINATE the modal's member walk by default — and the writers' pop-out shapes put a heading at the TOP of the pop-out's own content ('[Modal 1 Image] → [H3] Threading Beads → [Body]…' MXDI101 / MXEX201; '[modal] How do I convert? → [H5] → body → video → [close modal]' MXFL301/MXFU301/BLL243/MXDB302). Every such walk would stop dead at the heading, the bundle would be a one-marker hand-off box and the content would render loose. THREE COUPLED RULES, each with its own env toggle: (1) MODHEADMEM_OFF — the pop-out's own content heading is CAPTURED (InteractiveScanner.#modalHeadingMember; fences in its doc comment — XGF9003's hover matrix and ENGS102's lone modal are unaffected BY CONSTRUCTION); (2) MODCLOSER_OFF — '[close modal]' (which resolves to the SAME modal tag as a real invocation, unlike '[modal ends]' which resolves CONTAINER_CLOSE) never OPENS a bundle at the scan site (otherwise it would open one-marker closer boxes, as in EXPFUN05, and bundles that swallow the whole FOLLOWING SECTION, as in MXFL301/MXFU301) and ENDS the member walk of an UNNUMBERED bundle (consumed in range; residue like '(stop at 4:01)' surfaces via bundle.instructions — §6). A lexicon promote to CONTAINER_CLOSE is not used: most closers sit INTERLEAVED inside EXPFUN04/05's BUILT numbered tile modals, whose walks absorb them mid-run by design, so the numbered-member fence is what keeps those builds intact; (3) MODTRAILMEDIA_OFF — see trailing_media_keep_types. BUILD OUTCOMES: the label+content pop-outs build the writer's TKmodal (MXFU301-9.0's own gold is the model), where the gold sometimes substitutes a clickDrop reveal or flattened inline content (MXFL301, BLL243, MXDB302, ENFUN09); the no-address [Modal N Image] families (MXDI101/MXEX201) gather their content into the hand-off box and still decline honestly at the label/filename test. NOT COVERED: XGF9003's hover family (gold shapeHover), the layout-TABLE one-marker bundles, the ENGR302 nested-carousel modal, HES1005's media-list items, EXPFUN05's tile dialect, MXDB302's 'A Clever Tip' (unnumbered, closerless, multi-heading — no series evidence to key on).
modal_gathering.numbered_pattern_note: The numbered-series test: a digit INSIDE THE SAME BRACKET as the modal word (a lookahead pair, so '[3 Click modal XL…]' counts with the digit before the word). A bare /\d/ over the whole fold would read the '4' in a co-tag '[Modal] [H4]' (ENGI202) and the '2' in '(same as in FUNdamental phase 2)' (ENFUN07) as series evidence; this pattern prevents both.

same_block_label_absorb._comment: The same_block_image_absorb idea transposed to the modal. A writer types a modal as ONE LINE — '<the visible label> [Pop-out] <the pop-out content>' (XGF9004-9.0, XGF9002-4.0) — so the black lead is the trigger LABEL and the tag's trailing text is the pop-out. The member walk starts AT the first tag, so every LATER label is captured (it is the black item preceding the next tag) but the FIRST one would be left outside the bundle. This recovers it: the SAME source BLOCK only (the 'continuous sentence' discriminator), a single BLACK item, label-sized (the cap is READ FROM the builder: interactive_builders.modal.modal_sets.label_max_words, so absorb and build can never drift apart — a shared predicate), and only when the bundle's first member is the modal tag itself — a different block, a structural tag, an already-consumed item or a whole paragraph all decline, so it cannot swallow a real preceding element. Consumed in place and read by InteractiveBuilder.#modalSets (D2). Env MODALLEAD_OFF.

per_interactive_fields.heading_is_terminator: false = this widget legitimately contains internal headings (accordion strips, flip-card faces, ...) — do not terminate on [H2]-[H5].
per_interactive_fields.uses_data_table: true = a TABLE block after the tag carries the widget's option data.
per_interactive_fields.signature_subtags: SUBTAG-class canonical tags characteristic of this widget (Phase-4 slotting; Phase-1 detection confidence).
per_interactive_fields.nested_interactives_observed: Other interactive types historically observed INSIDE this widget's blocks (e.g. feedback modals in quizzes). Phase-1 policy is still 'new interactive terminates' — worst case the nested widget gets its own placeholder, which is safe.

glossary._note_heading_terminates: heading_is_terminator is true (as in OSAI201-01): the glossary is a flat Term–Meaning list with no internal headings, so otherwise the next [H3] section heading ('Types of AI') would be SWALLOWED into the glossary bundle. A heading terminates the capture so it renders as its own section heading after the glossary.

interactive._note_bare_interactive: The bare generic '[Interactive]' invocation (Tag_Lexicon qualifier_alias_demote.standalone_becomes). Conservative boundaries: headings terminate; uses_data_table so a [Body] ELEMENT after a captured data table terminates the walk (the writer resuming free body — otherwise AGH1001-01's post-table [Body] would be absorbed).
